"""A tiny game to build on. Change the numbers and see what happens."""

import pygame

from scene import Coin, Drawing, Rect, Scene

# Things you can change
WIDTH = 640
HEIGHT = 480
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
PLAYER_SIZE = 40
BACKGROUND = (18, 22, 34)
SCORE_COLOUR = (240, 240, 240)

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("My Game")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)
# Draw the player as a simple shape
player_shapes = [
    {"rect": [0, 0, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE], "color": "orange"}
]

# The scene: everything the game shows, drawn back to front by scene.draw().
scene = Scene(screen)
pizza = scene.add("pizza", Coin("red"),
                  size=(30, 30), at=(0, 0), moves=(0, 3), layer="things")
scene.add("player", Drawing((40, 40), [
    Rect(0, 0, 40, 40, "orange"),
]), rect=player, layer="player")

score = 0
font = pygame.font.Font(None, 36)

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            running = False

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    player.clamp_ip(screen.get_rect())

    scene.update()
    # Open Nest: touching pizza scores a point.
    for touched in scene.touched(player, "pizza"):
        score += 1
        touched.respawn()
    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)
    scene.draw()
    screen.blit(font.render(f"Score: {score}", True, SCORE_COLOUR), (10, 10))
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()
